Chapter 1085: 20 Eons Of Time (Please Subscribe)

Chapter 1085: Chapter 20 Eons of Time (Please Subscribe)

It was confirmed that Lin Yuan was the reincarnation of a Great Sage, which made Ancient Ming Venerable and the black-robed youth feel increasingly awed.

This meant that Lin Yuan’s existence spanned incomparably ancient and endless years.

His true identity might well be that of an Unparalleled Sage, known throughout the Chaos Void.

…

Inside the palace hall.

Wanqu Dominator received a nod from his master and immediately quoted the price.

“Brother Galaxy, all of these treasures combined—the final price is forty million Chaos Stones.”

Wanqu Dominator couldn’t help but feel astonished internally; such an enormous amount of Chaos Stones would make even a Venerable hesitant to part with them.

After all, Chaos Venerables incur substantial expenditures as well.

Take Ancient Ming Venerable, for example: his own consumption, the needs of his companion, the Chaos Dragon Beast,

and the expenditures to maintain the myriad formations on Ancient Ming’s Chaos Continent were all significant.

“Forty million Chaos Stones.” Lin Yuan nodded.

This exceeded his earlier estimation by quite a large margin. Lin Yuan hadn’t brought out all the treasures from his inheritance’s spatial storage, only intending to sell a portion for now.

Based on Lin Yuan’s judgment, those treasures he sold earlier were worth around twenty to thirty million Chaos Stones.

Forty million Chaos Stones? It was evident that Ancient Ming Venerable had offered an exorbitant price.

“Please convey my gratitude to the Venerable.”

Lin Yuan said.

Although he didn’t know why Ancient Ming Venerable was showing him such goodwill—be it through the Star Tear ‘Shard World’ or other gestures—

it wasn’t a bad thing, after all.

“I intend to purchase another batch of resources.”

Lin Yuan casually listed his desired cultivation resources.

“No problem.”

Wanqu Dominator patted his chest and assured him.

Now that the Ancient Ming Chaos Continent had become the trading hub for the nearby void, the resources Lin Yuan wanted were not rare and could be acquired easily.

…

Time passed.

A decade flew by in the blink of an eye.

Star Tear ‘Shard World’.

Lin Yuan sat cross-legged, his physical body emanating a deep and weighty aura that seemed to strain the surrounding space-time, twisting and warping it incessantly.

“The ‘Xuanhuang Physique’… it’s finally cultivated to perfection within the Dominator Realm.”

A smile emerged on Lin Yuan’s face. As the guardian technique of the Profound Xuanhuang lineage, and being a body refinement method, the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ tempered his physical body to near perfection in all aspects.

Even secret body-refinement techniques of the Great Sage level like the ‘Nine Tribulations Tuolong Body’ only slightly improved Lin Yuan’s physique in minor areas, whereas the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ remained central in its influence.

“Currently, my body should be approaching the physical level of Chaos Venerables…”

Lin Yuan thought to himself. The perfection of the Dominator-level ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ made his body arguably the strongest at the Dominator Realm level.

Additionally, due to Lin Yuan’s already extraordinary foundation of physical strength—especially the terrifyingly stable essence of his internal universe—his body was continuously enhanced, creating a virtuous cycle.

At this moment, Lin Yuan’s physical strength had reached a point where further improvement seemed almost impossible.

“Next, comes the Chaos Realm version of the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’…”

Lin Yuan contemplated for a moment before shaking his head.

The Chaos Realm ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ also demanded an adequately powerful life essence as its basis, a requirement he might only meet after fully entering the Dominator Realm.

“But the resources needed for perfecting Chaos Realm ‘Xuanhuang Physique’… tsk tsk.” Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

With his current physical foundation, if he could fully cultivate the ‘Xuanhuang Physique’ to perfection at the Chaos Realm, just his physical body alone would likely be enough to dominate the Chaos Great Saints.

However, the resources required to refine such a physique were staggering; for now, Lin Yuan couldn’t foresee how it could be achieved. He estimated that even the entire wealth of an Unparalleled Sage would fall far short.

“Step by step.”

Lin Yuan reined in his thoughts and stopped dwelling on the issue.

“And then there’s you.”

His thoughts stirred, and a palm-sized bell-shaped treasure appeared before him.

This was none other than the Primordial Bell meticulously nurtured by Lin Yuan.

Over the years, through Lin Yuan’s continuous cultivation and vast resource investments, the Primordial Bell had grown into a Dominator-tier treasure.

The Primordial Bell was deeply attuned to Lin Yuan’s spirit. Activating it required minimal effort, yet its power was immense—it rivaled even Chaos Realm treasures in capability.

“Come to think of it, I haven’t used you even once all this time…”

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

By his nature, he rarely acted unless he had absolute confidence in the outcome. In his daily life, he avoided dangerous situations entirely, relying on the appearances of his Primordial Spirit incarnations rather than exposing himself.

Thus, the Primordial Bell remained unused.

Still, despite its lack of opportunity to shine, such trump card treasures were non-negotiable in their importance; they might not be employed often, but they were crucial to possess.

This was why Lin Yuan had never abandoned the nurture of the Primordial Bell.

Many of the contingency measures and fatal techniques he had prepared over time had yet to be triggered, but he continued refining and adding to them.

“Directly using the Source Essence of my internal universe for its nurture.”

Lin Yuan stored the Primordial Bell within the depths of his internal universe, now vast and boundless, where the Chaos Tree presided majestically at its center, organizing and governing everything.

…

Home Universe.

The Cosmic Cataclysm had now completely concluded, and the once vast universe had condensed into a singular point.

The point was unimaginably small yet incomprehensibly immense; the surrounding space-time had compacted entirely, forbidding even Unparalleled Sages from perceiving its secrets.

The destruction and rebirth of the universe were natural evolutions dictated by the fundamental laws of the Chaos Void Origin, completely impervious to external interference.

Within the concentrated point.

Xuanhuang Secret Realm.

Now compressed into a miniature space measuring merely ten meters across.

Lin Yuan’s incarnate form sat at its center, carefully observing everything outside the secret realm.

Beyond the secret realm lay an expanse of primal chaos, utterly devoid of any influence from the Laws and Dao principles. The essence of the Cosmic Cataclysm was the complete annihilation of all such rules and principles.

However, for Lin Yuan, the seemingly dead and lifeless void outside the secret realm was, paradoxically, incredibly ‘wondrous’.

Through Lin Yuan’s perspective, though the external world was chillingly empty, he could faintly discern boundless laws slowly being nurtured into existence.
